title: Tic-Tik
tagline: A Time-Based Access Solution for Secure and Privacy-Preserving Verifications
description:
Tic-Tik addresses the following challenges on top of Anon Aadhaar SDK or any Rollups:

1. Time-Based Access Control:- Introduces a time-based access control mechanism, allowing operations to be performed only within specified timeframes after successful Anon Aadhaar verification. This enhances security by limiting access to authorized periods.

2. Segregation and Management of Operations:- Segregates and categorizes operations based on specific timeframes, ensuring that tasks related to elections, boarding, events, and more are executed systematically. This feature contributes to overall operational efficiency.

3. Fraud Mitigation in Time-Sensitive Processes:- Implements time-based access, reducing the risk of fraud by ensuring that operations are executed within predefined timeframes. This feature enhances the integrity of time-sensitive processes in various industries.

4. Versatile Applications in Different Industries:- Offers a solution for industries like entertainment, airlines, and more by providing time-specific access control. This versatility allows Tic-Tic to cater to a wide range of use cases beyond identity verification.

5. Enhanced Security for Sensitive Processes:- Adds an extra layer of security through time-based verification, ensuring that sensitive processes are conducted securely within specified timeframes. This feature enhances trust and reliability in critical operations.
